\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[paperwidth=400pt,paperheight=400pt,textwidth=280pt,textheight=180pt,centering]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\newwrite\Aentries
\immediate\openout\Aentries=\jobname.nodes
\newcount\Aformatted
\newcount\Aparruns
\let\Aformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{\global\advance\Aformatted by1\write\Aentries{ENTRY #1}\Aformat{#1}}
\makeatletter
\let\Askip\dte@skipcolumn
\newcount\Askips
\def\dte@skipcolumn{%
  \global\advance\Askips by1
  \typeout{AUDIT-SKIP \the\Askips;page=\thepage;goal=\the\pagegoal;total=\the\pagetotal;avail=\the\dte@availht;min=\dte@minht}%

  \Askip}
\let\Amin\dte@compute@minht
\def\dte@compute@minht{\Amin\typeout{AUDIT-MIN total=\dte@minht;depth=\the\dte@tempdim}}
\let\Apiece\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{\typeout{AUDIT-PIECE #1;page=\thepage;ht=\the\ht\dte@splitresult;dp=\the\dp\dte@splitresult}\Apiece{#1}}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{AUDIT-PARRUNS \the\Aparruns}\typeout{AUDIT-FORMATTED \the\Aformatted}\typeout{AUDIT-PIECES \the\dte@piecenum}}
\makeatother
\AddToHook{shipout/before}{}
\AddToHook{para/before}{\ifinner\else\ifvmode\ifnum\value{page}>0\relax\global\advance\Aparruns by1\relax\typeout{AUDIT-PAR \the\Aparruns;page=\thepage}\hrule height150pt\relax\fi\fi\fi}

\makeatletter
\@ifundefined{dte@check@progress}{}{%
  \let\AuditCheck\dte@check@progress
  \def\dte@check@progress#1#2{%
    \typeout{AUDIT-CHECK #1; deficit=\the\dimexpr#2\relax; goal=\the\pagegoal; vsize=\the\vsize; total=\the\pagetotal}%
    \AuditCheck{#1}{#2}%
    \typeout{AUDIT-RESULT room=\meaning\dte@retryroom; stop=\if@tempswa YES\else NO\fi}%
  }}
\makeatother


\newcount\Abegincount
\newcount\Aendcount
\newwrite\Abegin
\immediate\openout\Abegin=\jobname.begin
\AddToHook{para/begin}{\ifinner\else
\global\advance\Abegincount by1\relax
\write\Abegin{BEGIN}%
\fi}
\AddToHook{para/end}{\ifinner\else\global\advance\Aendcount by1\relax\fi}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{RESUME-BEGINCOUNT \the\Abegincount}\typeout{RESUME-ENDCOUNT \the\Aendcount}}

\makeatletter
\let\AuditResumeSkip\dte@skipcolumn
\def\AuditResumeState#1{%
  \edef\AuditResumeInfo{mode=\ifhmode H\else V\fi;node=\the\lastnodetype;shape=\the\parshape;hang=\the\hangindent;after=\the\hangafter}%
  \typeout{RESUME-#1 \AuditResumeInfo}}
\def\dte@skipcolumn{%
  \AuditResumeState{PRE}%
  \AuditResumeSkip
  \AuditResumeState{POST}%
}
\makeatother


\makeatletter
\ifcsname dte@check@defer\endcsname
  \let\DGcheck\dte@check@defer
  \def\dte@check@defer{%
    \typeout{DG-DEFER attempt=\the\numexpr\dte@defercount+1\relax;piece=\the\dte@pagecount;tree=\the\dte@tnum}%
    \DGcheck}
\fi
\makeatother
